description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality outcomes. This pivotal role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment.If you are a proven leader with a strong background in skilled nursing facility administration and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to excellence and innovation in healthcare.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
